about_the_game:
A Sun falls down, 

Vitriol is a fast paced physics VR shooter, iterating on the physics interaction of projects like Boneworks or Blade & Sorcery to bring you the brutal, ultraviolent worlds of games like Doom(2016) and Ultrakill in Virtual Reality.

  • Across the Campaign you will burn down 7 kingdoms and their seven kings; You the Eighth and who is of the seven, will go into perdition. 

  • Physics Based enemies move with a weight and ferocity that puts impact into their lives, and deaths. 

  • Test your metal in a scored Arcade Mode, remixing weapons & abilities in a one life stomping of the masses.

and The Snake eats it's tail.

  • Damage done is Health gained, use the power punch to inject your Harvest

  • Movement Unlike before, Create your own leverage to push off nothingness with the Air Mantle

  • Feel the Impact of your fist through a full collision Torque based Arm System

Burn & Fallow

  • Kill with an arsenal of 8 uniquely actioned weapons: Hammers, Slides, Levers, Bolts. And we wouldn't forget the simple fun of a Double Barrel Shotgun.

  • Weapon Mods change more than just bullets. The Weight and Interaction of a weapon has just as much influence as its mode. Mods change the way a weapon is handled as well as fired. 

  • Runes...   also, SUPER PUNCH & GRAPPLING HOOOOOK!

content_descriptors.notes: Blow up low poly enemies and watch the 16 bit blood rain down. Mature context extends to low poly violence and occasional crude language/swearing and written descriptions of violent acts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 7600 3.5ghz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / 1660TI (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Big Old Loud One
  • VR Support: OpenXR !Thumbstick and (AB buttons or Trackpad) Required! Oculus Touch, Valve Index, Windows MR, HP Reverb
  • Additional Notes: CPU performance required for physics calculations! SSD Required, 32GB Windows Virtual Memory Cache
